acceptance_advice: Add absent .work, absent batch, absent source-catalog parent, absent leaf, identical reuse, differing stable cache and foreign post-absence byte-identical appearance fixtures.

Race cache ancestor replacement, complete-set additions, leaf replacement, permission/mode/hardlink/symlink/nonregular changes during both normal and exception exits; assert WORK_PATH_UNSAFE over ordinary status/reader errors.

Mutate a package .py/resource registry/resource file and add/remove a package/resource sibling between generation prepass and projection/finalization; assert deterministic safety refusal and no cache overwrite.
Keep the source-catalog artifact free of local cache path/inode/batch/runtime installation path while retaining those values only in safety state.

checks.evidence: Lines 27-43 require one retained Vault session, collect_source_state(require_rendered=True), complete rendered pages/head registries, retained Vault ancestors/inventory sets/bytes, and final safety precedence. This is the correct authority boundary for empty, legacy typed, registered-unowned and modern states.

Lines 62-73 bind resources, every installed-package .py file, runtime versions and rows hash, and reject changed generation bytes. The implementation must retain the package/resource registry ancestor trees and complete sets around projection; hashing a preselected file list alone cannot detect an added/deleted .py or registry resource.

Lines 37-43 and 200-209 require absent status to reconstruct valid current state without creating .work/batch/cache and to preserve safety precedence. The existing create/open batch session pattern cannot be called blindly for an absent batch; a noncreating retained cache-path inspection must represent first-missing parent and absent leaf explicitly.

Lines 190-196 define mode 0600 create, byte-identical no-rewrite reuse, differing preexisting bytes as SOURCE_CATALOG_CONFLICT, and post-absent foreign appearance as WORK_PATH_UNSAFE. The implementation needs an atomic install/adopt state that records the creator identity and verifies every created ancestor/complete parent set; it must never turn a post-absence appearance into reuse.

The packet explicitly gives final safety failure priority over absence/stale/not-found/input and preserves lower-level ContractError fields. Cache conflict, malformed cache, reader absence/stale and generation/source errors must remain distinguishable until retained finalization; a final named-edge/complete-set failure must become WORK_PATH_UNSAFE.

The 17 paths cover one catalog resource, docs/schema, store/CLI/public catalog/contract/IO/projection/query modules, command-tree/schema integration and contract/security/unit/upstream tests. No arbitrary output/cache path or unrelated seed/overlay path is introduced.

findings.advice: Freeze a helper contract that retains the nearest existing no-follow ancestor, exact complete set, first missing component and remaining fixed suffix; status/readers use create=False; build atomically creates each missing component or cache file, records the installed identities/mode0600, and verifies the original absent edge plus all newly created edges on every exit. A foreign appearance after absence is WORK_PATH_UNSAFE even when bytes match.
findings.problem: The contract requires retaining the cache file, every named ancestor, and an absent slot/first missing ancestor, while status on a missing batch must not create it. It does not define which descriptor/complete-set state represents a missing .work, batch or source-catalog parent, nor how the first missing ancestor becomes owned after build creates the chain. Existing fixed batch-session open/create primitives cannot by themselves inspect an absent batch without creation or safely retain a missing parent.
findings.title: First-missing cache ancestor needs an explicit retained state machine

findings.advice: Require descriptor-relative retained trees for installed video_paper_wiki package sources and the package/repo resource registry/resource ancestors, with complete sets and exact bytes before and after projection. Enumerate the profile-owned resource names from that retained registry, reject aliases/symlinks/hardlinks/nonregular files, and perform no CWD fallback. Any generation lineage change wins as WORK_PATH_UNSAFE.
findings.problem: The required generation list is complete only if the package .py tree and package/repo resource registry cannot change between enumeration, projection and final cache installation. Rechecking hashes for a previously enumerated list misses a newly added or removed implementation/resource file and an ancestor replacement. The packet says bytes are captured/rechecked but does not explicitly require complete-set/ancestor retention for those external generation inputs.
findings.title: Generation file hashes need retained directory and registry lineage

findings.advice: Bind profile_sha256 to an exact packaged profile resource or define an explicit canonical profile object and digest domain (including row groups/keys, limits, tokenizer, resolution reasons and runtime/resource policy), with a no-self-hash rule. Add that resource/hash to the exact freeze and installed-wheel parity checks.
findings.problem: The artifact requires generation.profile_sha256 but the packet defines neither the bytes it hashes nor a profile resource/name in the allowlist. Independent builders cannot reproduce the digest or distinguish a changed row/group/tokenizer/resolution profile from a changed runtime/resource list. A self-hash equation is also not stated for this field.
findings.title: profile_sha256 has no canonical input formula
